sundari-palace.text: Epic Action: For each friendly leader unit, you may resource a card from your hand and ready it. If you do, defeat that many friendly resources at the start of the regroup phase.
sundari-palace.officialRules: At the start of the regroup phase, defeat a number of friendly resources equal to the number of cards resourced when you used the ability.
sundari-palace.officialTextStyled: Epic Action: For each friendly leader unit, you may resource a card from your hand and ready it. If you do, defeat that many friendly resources at the start of the regroup phase.

han-solo--audacious-smuggler.text: Action [exhaust]: Put a card from your hand into play as a resource and ready it. At the start of the next action phase, defeat a resource you control.
han-solo--audacious-smuggler.rules: Han’s ability’s requirement to defeat a resource remains active even if he is defeated or changes zones before the start of the next action phase.
han-solo--audacious-smuggler.officialRules: Han’s ability’s requirement to defeat a resource remains active even if he is defeated or changes zones before the start of the next action phase.
han-solo--audacious-smuggler.officialTextStyled: Action []: Put a card from your hand into play as a resource and ready it. At the start of the next action phase, defeat a resource you control.
han-solo--audacious-smuggler.epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 6 or more resources, deploy this leader.
han-solo--audacious-smuggler.deployBox: On Attack: Put the top card of your deck into play as a resource and ready it. At the start of the next action phase, defeat a resource you control.
